title: The Many Faces of Anger: A Multicultural Video Dataset of Negative Emotions in the Wild (MFA-Wild)
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on the creation and analysis of a multicultural dataset for emotion recognition. While it briefly references psychological research linking certain emotions to moral codes (the CAD triad hypothesis), this is not a central component of the work. The paper does not evaluate, benchmark, or build models related to faith, morals, or ethics.
